mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, type, detail_json, user_id
mapper.select: select ct.id id, cpc.no projectContentEnum, cpc.name projectContent, ct.type category, case when ct.measure_mode = 1 then '米' else '平方米' end unit, case when ct.measure_mode = 1 then Round(ct.quantity_work/1000,2) else Round(ct.quantity_work/1000/1000,2) end quantityWork from contract_tech ct left join contract_project_content cpc on ct.type = cpc.no where project_id = #{projectId} and ct.bool_delete_enum = 0 and type != 1
